worker-metrics-board.panels.invocationsB: Every invocation, split by what triggered it: HTTP, JS RPC, connect(), queues, alarms, cron, tail and email.
Invocations per Worker version, so a gradual deployment shows each version’s share.
worker-metrics-board.panels.responseStat: HTTP status codes the Worker returned.
V8 isolate memory at the end of each invocation. Rising memory often comes with more garbage collection.
worker-metrics-board.panels.errorRate.de: Share of invocations that failed, not counting client disconnects, and share that returned an HTTP 5xx status.
worker-metrics-board.panels.errorsByOutc: Invocations that did not succeed, by why they failed: an uncaught exception, CPU or memory limits, a client disconnect and more.
worker-metrics-board.panels.topErrors.de: The most common error messages in Workers Logs. Needs Workers Logs to be on for this Worker.
worker-metrics-board.panels.cpuTime.desc: CPU time each invocation used, as percentiles.
worker-metrics-board.panels.wallTime.des: Elapsed time each invocation took, including time spent waiting on I/O.
worker-metrics-board.panels.requestDurat: Time from the first byte of the request until the response finished.
CPU time spent evaluating the Worker’s script when a new isolate starts. Only invocations that started an isolate count.
worker-metrics-board.panels.coldStarts.d: Invocations that started a new isolate. These spike after a deployment.
worker-metrics-board.panels.gcTime.title: Garbage collection time
worker-metrics-board.panels.gcTime.descr: Time V8 spent collecting garbage, as percentiles over invocations that ran a collection, and garbage collection as a share of all CPU time. It is part of CPU time.
Mark-compact collections. A rising count is a sign of memory pressure.
worker-metrics-board.panels.subrequestsB: Hosts this Worker sends fetch() requests to.
worker-metrics-board.panels.subrequestLa: Slowest 1% of responses from each host.
worker-metrics-board.panels.subrequestSt: HTTP status codes returned to this Worker’s subrequests.
worker-metrics-board.panels.topLocations: Cloudflare data centers that ran this Worker.
worker-metrics-board.panels.cacheRequest: Requests to the cache in front of this Worker, by cache status (hit, miss, expired and so on).
worker-metrics-board.panels.cacheHitRate: Share of requests to the cache in front of this Worker that were served from cache.
worker-metrics-board.panels.locationsGlo: Cloudflare data centers that ran this Worker, sized by invocations.
worker-metrics-board.panels.locationsTab: Invocations, error rate and CPU time P99 in each data center. Errors are exceptions and HTTP 5xx responses. Values well above the other locations are highlighted.
worker-metrics-board.panels.logVolume.de: Workers Logs events over time, by level.
worker-metrics-board.panels.topLogMessag: The most common warning and error log messages.
